# Contributing Guidelines

Thanks for being interested in contributing to our project in some way.  To keep things brief, here are the quick notes.

## Policies

- Review our [AI usage policy](https://github.com/open-goal/jak-project/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md)
- No Android or mobile related contributions will be accepted, we aren't interested.

## The Hopefully Obvious

- Try to ensure your changes are well tested, clean and organized
- Be respectful, don't act like someone you would never want to associate with
- Be aware that depending on what you submit, it may not merge soon or ever depending on what it is.  Don't take this personally -- reach out to us first to see if there is an appetite first before investing massive amounts of time into it.
